An index calculation at zero or below for an adjusted return index gives rise to an index termination and a termination announcement. The termination is linked to that calculation, and the announcement is made by Solactive on the Solactive Website under the News Section as soon as reasonably possible after the calculation.

A termination qualified by other reasons is in accordance with Solactive Policies.
